page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with two diagrams set within the text block (a curved and straight parallel figure, and a pair of converging lines), and one running head at the top. Small italic passage in the middle. Marginal diagrams and labels are inside the text block. Catchword-like signature "Perpen-" at lower right, printed as the start of the next word.

main_text.l: Æqualiter distantes sunt lineæ duæ vel
plures, quæ æquali à se inuicem spacio vndique
Linearum Parallelarum hoc est, Theor. Lineæ
Parallelæ siue æqualiter distantes in infinitum
Possunt autem lineæ Parallelæ esse tum rectæ,

l.i: circulares vero Par. in tabulis pingi non possunt, sed
experimuntur euidenter per rotas alicuius currus: etenim
earum siue orbita quæ est ab vna parte currus est parallela ipsi rotæ
quæ est ab altera parte currus: itaque currus quando
procedit, & mouetur, semper mouetur inter 4. circulos parallelos.

main_text.l: altera ad alteram magis vel minus inclinat.

page.notes: Two diagrams within the text: first shows a curved parallel line and straight parallel lines labelled α, β, γ, δ; second shows two converging lines labelled α, β, γ, δ with the words "linea hæc magis ab inf. distat". The labels in the diagrams are partly illegible. The text of the diagram labels is not transcribed as running text. Long s rendered as s. The running head is "ELEMENTA GEOMETR." as printed.
